children: Krause L William, a Director, reported a sale of common stock on August 28, 2026. The filing lists a weighted average selling price of $6.745 per share (price range $6.68 to $6.775). The total sale amount reported was $1,188,037. Following the transaction, Krause directly owns 98,371 shares of common stock, which include 16,807 restricted stock units subject to vesting conditions.
